marker: SCP-JP Wikidot y2k narrow top bar: give the narrow top bar the theme teal ground so its labels stay readable over the halftone band.
rationale: W13 G2-09 fix in the acceptance frame: the narrow top-nav labels render over the halftone band with no bar background and are hard to read at 320 (D-4; the native 320 frame is clean per the G2-27 AB check, so this is a JP-frame composition effect; the pre-freeze white-label remedy remains refuted and is NOT used). The W13 block gives the narrow top bar the theme's own dark teal ground (#0c4f47) so the existing label color reads against a solid band. Before frame db726bb9 (labels over the dot pattern) -> after frame 521de916 (labels on the teal ground, readable; the first label's left edge still passes behind the theme's circular emblem, a composition trait of the theme), page.normal narrow-mobile.
